item.title: Hexa Coin
item.description:
Project Overview

Genre: Puzzle based game
Platform: Mobile (Android/IOS)
Technologies Used: Unity, C#, Mobile Optimization
Play Store Link

Description

Improved Hexa Coin (Android, VOODOO), a live puzzle game with 100K+ downloads, by delivering 8+ post-launch updates that enhanced gameplay feel, progression, and user experience in collaboration with BeachBum and VOODOO teams. Implemented key systems like Revive, Hint, Target, and Quick Revive to boost re-engagement, while integrating Unity Addressables and VOODOO event tracking for dynamic asset loading, real-time economy monitoring, and seamless live content updates.
